target.title: Fix serve deadline leaving orphan in-flight work
target.body:
## Summary

- Replace `serveResponseWithDeadline`'s continuation-based race with a `TaskGroup` that cancels and drains the losing task before returning.
- When `codexbar serve` hit its request deadline and returned 504, the old handler cancelled work but did not wait for it to finish. The response cache then allowed a new fetch while the previous provider work kept running, which can stack across refresh cycles (related to #1999 / #1004).
- Add regression tests that assert timed-out serve work is actually torn down, including across sequential deadline timeouts.

This is intentionally narrow: it does not claim to fully close #1999 without the reporter diagnostics steipete requested (PID/PPID, statusLine usage, `sample`/`lsof`). URLSession hardening across individual providers is left for a follow-up.

## Test plan

- [x] `swift test --filter CLIServeRouterTests`
- [x] New: `serve deadline cancels in-flight work before returning timeout`
- [x] New: `sequential serve deadline timeouts do not stack in-flight work`
